en: A black-and-white postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with detached houses and gardens. The homes have steep gabled roofs and wooden facades typical of early 20th‑century Scandinavian villas. A low fence and gate border the foreground property, and there is an unpaved or lightly paved road with grassy verges. Trees and shrubs obscure much of the lower parts of the houses. Handwritten-style text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
